title: Reduce visual noise and resolve ghost focus for toggle & icon buttons
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Several regressions surfaced after the interaction-token migration and compact density changes: icon-only and toggle buttons show a transient focus halo ("ghost focus") when switching between states (pressed -> loading -> disabled). High-contrast mode accentuates the ring and in RTL layouts the spinner replacement shifts the icon leading to perceived jitter. This ticket reduces visual noise, standardizes loading/disabled behavior across variants, and documents token changes for engineers.
goals: Eliminate ghost focus ring across press -> loading -> disabled transitions
Keep hitbox and layout stable when spinner appears (no width collapse or icon shift)
Establish token-level defaults for icon, toggle, and compact variants that respect theming and high-contrast
Provide clear migration notes and a small test harness for QA/Eng to validate regressions
design_decisions: Use an overlay spinner (absolute positioned) with preserved padding instead of replacing the icon node to avoid layout shifts
Preserve focus ring state visually when transitioning to loading but reduce opacity to 0.24 to avoid 'ghosting' while still meeting 3:1 contrast for keyboard users
Introduce a new token button.loading.overlayOpacity and set default 0.6 for dark themes, 0.5 for light themes; allow overrides per-brand
For icon-only buttons keep hitbox at 40px min and center the spinner within the hitbox instead of shrinking the hit target
In RTL mode ensure spinner rotation and positioning respect directionality; add test vectors to the component stories
tradeoffs: Overlay spinner keeps DOM stable but requires absolute positioning and an additional z-layer — slight complexity increase in CSS vs replacing the icon node
Lowering focus opacity reduces perceived accessibility feedback; to mitigate we keep a visible but subdued ring and add an optional visible focus indicator toggle for assistive users
Maintaining 40px hitbox for compact icon buttons increases visual density compared to older 32px, but reduces mis-taps and layout jitter across states
acceptance_criteria: When reproducing press -> loading -> disabled the focus ring should not flicker or jump (automated visual snapshot added)
Icon-only and toggle buttons do not change width/height when entering loading state across light/dark/high-contrast themes
New tokens documented in design tokens README and referenced in the PR
QA harness (storybook stories) includes: LTR/RTL, light/dark, high-contrast, keyboard-only navigation path
Frontend PR merged and E2E visual snapshots show no regressions vs baseline for the affected components
